question: Should OpenClaw make `registerReadinessCriterion` and operator-selected readiness criteria a supported Plugin SDK contract, then accept built-in hosting profiles that depend on it?
rationale: This PR introduces an externally consumed SDK extension and deployment-facing readiness semantics; implementation correctness cannot decide the intended long-term public contract.

options.title: Approve the readiness contract stack
options.body: Confirm the Plugin SDK and readiness-selection direction, land the dependency PRs in order, then review this profile layer against the accepted base.

options.title: Defer plugin readiness registration
options.body: Keep the core profile idea but remove or defer plugin criterion registration until maintainers define a narrower supported extension contract.

options.title: Pause the hosting-profile program
options.body: Do not add the profiles until a maintainer-sponsored product and deployment-readiness plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve the readiness contract stack
recommendation.body: Confirm the Plugin SDK and readiness-selection direction, land the dependency PRs in order, then review this profile layer against the accepted base.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked RFC and implementation stack and can provide the technical contract context, while a repository maintainer must make the final product decision.
